name: Indeed US
description: Indeed US job search, full job postings and employer profiles (rating, review category scores, size, revenue, industry, addresses, CEO, links) from Indeed's own GraphQL API, with the public company page as fallback and salary and location normalised.

tools.name: Employer
tools.description: Employer research after search or job returned an employer key or url. Prefer employer_key (solver-free, one GraphQL call); unknown keys and slugs return not_found.

options.name: company
options.about: Company page slug as it appears after /cmp/, e.g. Apple or Charles-Schwab.

options.name: employer_key
options.about: Indeed's employer key as returned in employer.key on search and job results, e.g. e3a48f8a4a788271. Pattern: ^[0-9a-fA-F]{16}$.

options.name: url
options.about: A pasted indeed.com company URL, e.g. https://www.indeed.com/cmp/Apple.

response.about: One Indeed employer profile by employer key (the 16-hex employer.key on every job), by company page slug (the name after /cmp/) or by a pasted indeed.com/cmp URL: name, overall rating and review count, review category scores (work-life balance, compensation, job security, management, culture), description, industry (code plus label), employee and revenue ranges (code plus label), addresses, website and social links, CEO name, logo and header image URLs. Read from Indeed's GraphQL employer dossier; a slug is resolved to its key through a company: job search. Only when the company has no current US posting is the public company page read instead, which additionally exposes founded year, headquarters, Work Happiness score, ratings by year, top locations, open job count and CEO approval; data_source names the path taken.

fields.name: addresses
fields.about: Addresses as listed in the employer dossier; empty from the company page.

fields.name: company_key
fields.about: Indeed's encrypted company id (encodedFccId); matches employer.key on jobs.

fields.name: data_source
fields.about: Which Indeed surface produced this record: the GraphQL employer dossier or the public company page fallback.

fields.name: employee_range
fields.about: Decoded from employee_range_code, e.g. "10,000+"; null when the code is unknown.

fields.name: employee_range_code
fields.about: Indeed's raw code, e.g. ERv1_10000_PLUS.

fields.name: industry_code
fields.about: Indeed's raw industry code, e.g. Iv1_INTERNET_AND_SOFTWARE (GraphQL path only; null from the company page).

fields.name: rating
fields.about: Overall review rating out of 5.

fields.name: revenue_range
fields.about: Decoded from revenue_range_code, USD, e.g. "more than $10B (USD)".

fields.name: revenue_range_code
fields.about: Indeed's raw code, e.g. RRv1_OVER_10B.

fields.name: social_links
fields.about: Employer-provided social profile URLs (GraphQL path); null from the company page.

response.description: Our mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more.
response.name: Microsoft

tools.name: Job
tools.description: After search, or when you hold a viewjob?jk= or rc/clk?jk= URL. Removed postings return not_found.

options.name: job_key
options.about: Indeed job key, e.g. d6adfa9517df46fc. Pattern: ^[0-9a-fA-F]{16}$.

options.name: url
options.about: A pasted indeed.com job URL containing jk=, e.g. https://www.indeed.com/viewjob?jk=d6adfa9517df46fc.

response.about: One Indeed job posting by job key (the 16-hex jk) or a pasted indeed.com job URL: title, employer, normalised location and salary, attributes, description as HTML and text, posted/listed timestamps, repost flag, expiry flag and outbound apply URL.

fields.name: attributes
fields.about: Indeed's taxonomy tags for the posting, as Indeed returns them: skills, benefits, schedule, seniority, job type and, when tagged, the workplace type. The workplace type (key DSQF7 "Remote", PAXZC "Hybrid work", SWG7T "In-person", N83EH "Work from home") is optional: it is present only on postings Indeed tagged with it, so its absence does not mean on-site. Order is Indeed's; the list may be empty.

fields.name: listed_at
fields.about: RFC3339 UTC; Indeed's dateOnIndeed, when the posting was listed on Indeed.

fields.name: posted_at
fields.about: RFC3339 UTC; Indeed's datePublished, the posting date the employer's listing carries. For a reposted posting this is the repost date, not the original one.

fields.name: reposted
fields.about: Indeed's isRepost: true when Indeed marks the posting as a repost of an earlier one, false when not, null when Indeed does not say.

response.description_html:
At Apple, we focus deeply on our customers’ experience. Apple Ads brings this same approach to advertising, helping people find exactly what they’re looking for and helping advertisers grow their businesses. Our technology powers ads and sponsorships across Apple Services, including the App Store, Apple News, and MLS Season Pass. Everything we do is designed for trust, connection, and impact: We respect user privacy, integrate advertising thoughtfully into the experience, and deliver value for advertisers of all sizes-from small app developers to big, global brands. Because when advertising is done right, it benefits everyone.

Description

Ads Engineering builds ad tech the Apple way-privacy-preserving, user-centric, and built to scale. Our infrastructure supports massive real-time demand with low latency, precision, and global reach. Our work spans distributed systems, large-scale data infrastructure, LLMs, and Generative AI. We design and build best of breed systems for dealing with our complex and ever-growing platform needs that help deliver highly optimized advertising content to consumers.","responsibilities":"Build the foundational pieces of the next generation of Apple Ad’s systems

Implement low latency, highly - available, high volume internal and external facing services in a cloud environment.

Design and implement performant services created with the right principles to support rapid growth with minimal operational overheads

Collaborate with cross functional teams including Product Management, Data, SRE, etc. to design and implement systems that can handle a variety of Ads use cases.

Preferred Qualifications

Master's degree preferred

5+ years of experience in software engineering

Proficiency in Java

Prior experience in advertising industry is a plus

Minimum Qualifications

2 or more years of industry experience building scalable micro services or data driven platforms

Strong computer science fundamentals

Prior experience with OOPS programming (eg., Java/C++ or equivalent)

Familiarity with cloud paradigms ( e.g AWS or GCP )

Expertise in building backend distributed systems

Experience with creating solutions using public cloud technologies and APIs

Strong understanding of Micro-service design and high-scale performance tuning

Expertise in relational and non relational datastore

Proficiency in data processing technologies (e.g Kafka, Spark, Flink )

Strong problem solving and debugging skills

A desire to work in a fast-paced work environment

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science/Engineering discipline or equivalent

Pay & Benefits

At Apple, base pay is one part of our total compensation package and is determined within a range. This provides the opportunity to progress as you grow and develop within a role. The base pay range for this role is between $129,300 and $225,300, and your base pay will depend on your skills, qualifications, experience, and location.

Apple employees also have the opportunity to become an Apple shareholder through participation in Apple's discretionary employee stock programs. Apple employees are eligible for discretionary restricted stock unit awards, and can purchase Apple stock at a discount if voluntarily participating in Apple's Employee Stock Purchase Plan. You'll also receive benefits including: Comprehensive medical and dental coverage, retirement benefits, a range of discounted products and free services, and for formal education related to advancing your career at Apple, reimbursement for certain educational expenses - including tuition. Additionally, this role might be eligible for discretionary bonuses or commission payments as well as relocation. Learn more about Apple Benefits

Note: Apple benefit, compensation and employee stock programs are subject to eligibility requirements and other terms of the applicable plan or program.

tools.name: Search
tools.description: Start here to find job_key values; pass the same filters plus next_cursor to page. No total count is exposed by Indeed; next_cursor=null is the end.

options.name: cursor
options.about: next_cursor from the previous page; send it with the same query, location and filters.

options.name: location
options.about: City and state, ZIP code, state, or "Remote" (Indeed's "where" box). At least one of query/location is required.

options.name: posted_within_days
options.about: Only cards Indeed listed within the last N days, i.e. on listed_at (Indeed's dateOnIndeed, the only field its date filter accepts). posted_at is not filtered: it can be older than N days, and for a reposted card it is the repost date. Check reposted and posted_at on each card.

options.name: query
options.about: Job title, keywords or company name (Indeed's "what" box).

options.name: radius_miles
options.about: Search radius around the location in miles.

options.name: remote
options.about: true restricts to jobs carrying Indeed's Remote attribute.

options.name: sort
options.about: Result order: "relevance" (Indeed's default ranking) or "date" (most recently listed first). No other order is offered by Indeed.

response.about: Search Indeed US job postings by keywords and/or location (city/state, ZIP or "Remote"), with radius, newest-first sort, posted-within-days and remote filters. Returns one page of up to 100 job cards with normalised salary (min/max, currency, period, posted vs estimated), location, employer, attributes, Indeed's own posted/listed timestamps and repost flag, plus next_cursor. posted_within_days filters on listed_at (when Indeed listed the card), the only date Indeed's filter accepts; a card's posted_at can be weeks older, and for reposted=true it is the repost date, not the original posting date.

fields.name: apply_url
fields.about: Indeed's outbound apply URL, when present.

fields.name: attributes
fields.about: Indeed's taxonomy tags for the posting, as Indeed returns them: skills, benefits, schedule, seniority, job type and, when tagged, the workplace type. The workplace type (key DSQF7 "Remote", PAXZC "Hybrid work", SWG7T "In-person", N83EH "Work from home") is optional: it is present only on postings Indeed tagged with it and absent on many cards, so its absence does not mean on-site. Order is Indeed's; the list may be empty.

fields.name: job_key
fields.about: Indeed's stable job key (jk).

fields.name: listed_at
fields.about: RFC3339 UTC; Indeed's dateOnIndeed, when this card was listed on Indeed. The field posted_within_days filters on.

fields.name: posted_at
fields.about: RFC3339 UTC; Indeed's datePublished, the posting date the employer's listing carries. For a reposted card this is the repost date, not the original one; it is not what posted_within_days filters on.

fields.name: reposted
fields.about: Indeed's isRepost: true when Indeed marks the posting as a repost of an earlier one (posted_at is then the repost date), false when it does not, null when Indeed does not say. Read from Indeed's jobData for the page, since the search surface leaves it null.

fields.name: snippet
fields.about: First 300 characters of the description text.

fields.name: source_name
fields.about: The board or employer Indeed sourced the posting from.

fields.name: source_url
fields.about: https://www.indeed.com/viewjob?jk=<job_key>
